# BYZ scope. Gold per thousand ducats of the Venetian claims: 0.15 months of income.
oe_itp_kd = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 0.15
}

# BYZ scope. Thousand ducats paid at a renewal: the claims, at most 10.
oe_itp_due_kd = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims } value = var:oe_itp_ven_claims }
    max = 10
    min = 0
}

# BYZ scope. The instalment of .1 in gold.
oe_itp_due = {
    value = oe_itp_due_kd
    multiply = oe_itp_kd
}

# BYZ scope. Three instalments (the AI lets the treaty lapse only when poorer than this).
oe_itp_due3 = {
    value = oe_itp_due
    multiply = 3
}

# BYZ scope. The navy size of Venice (0 if gone); compared with our navy_size.
oe_itp_navy_ven = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } value = c:VEN.navy_size }
}

# BYZ scope. The navy size of Genoa (0 if gone); compared with our navy_size.
oe_itp_navy_gen = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } value = c:GEN.navy_size }
}

# BYZ scope. Half the Venetian navy (the haggling bonus of .1 b).
oe_itp_navy_ven_half = {
    value = oe_itp_navy_ven
    multiply = 0.5
}

# BYZ scope. Chance in percent that haggling in .1 b succeeds (design 3.5).
oe_itp_haggle_ch = {
    value = 30
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            c:VEN = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { country_exists = c:GEN is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
                    AND = { country_exists = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR }
                }
            }
        }
        add = 20
    }
    if = { limit = { navy_size >= oe_itp_navy_ven_half } add = 15 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims var:oe_itp_ven_claims > 20 } add = -15 }
    min = 5
    max = 80
}

# BYZ scope. Debt still owed on X1 loans from Venice (loc key oe_itp_loan_ven).
oe_itp_loan_left_ven = {
    value = 0
    every_loan = { limit = { has_loc_key = oe_itp_loan_ven } add = remaining_debt }
}

# BYZ scope. What oe_itp_borrow lends from Venice at its tier.
oe_itp_borrow_amt_ven = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } value = oe_itp_m4 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 } value = oe_itp_m8 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 } value = oe_itp_m12 }
}

# BYZ scope. Yearly interest in percent of oe_itp_borrow from Venice.
oe_itp_borrow_pct_ven = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 1 } value = 8 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2 } value = 6 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 3 } value = 4 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_foreign_banks_banned has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven >= 1 }
        add = 1
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Chance of a reprisal after revoking Venice's privileges (30%, x1.5 when their navy is larger than ours).
oe_itp_rep_ch_ven = {
    value = 30
    if = { limit = { navy_size < oe_itp_navy_ven } multiply = 1.5 }
}

# BYZ scope. Redeeming Venice's pledge: 8 months of income, 4 with 60 months or less left.
oe_itp_redeem_ven = {
    value = oe_itp_m4
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t3m_ven var:oe_itp_t3m_ven > 60 } value = oe_itp_m8 }
}
